decision.rationale: Numerical comparison before scarce experiments: sensor_lag training RMSE 0.083C BIC -1749 on initial-0,1,2 vs linear 0.29C BIC -856 and quadratic_loss 0.29C BIC -844; action-2 alternate probe RMSE 0.079C and action-4 both-release probe RMSE 0.073C show no_mismatch_observed for initial model on those inputs only, not global confirmation. Stage provisional sensor_lag fit on all five observations; fitting does not establish mechanism or future accuracy.
